## Summary
Ayodele Ayoola is a Software Engineer based in London, UK, with 4 years of professional experience since November 2022. He works across frontend, backend and cross-platform mobile with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Flutter and React Native, and has built payment and authentication systems, real-time workflows, geospatial visualisation, LLM-powered features and AI agents. He holds a BSc (Hons) in IT & Business Information Systems with First-Class Honours from Middlesex University London (2025).

   Property intelligence across valuations, planning, investment analysis and tokenisation. Atlas 2D/3D maps, Chrome and Firefox Property Assistant, 20+ legacy tables replaced with a shared TanStack DataTable, CI checks cut from 7-15 minutes to under 2 (code-to-release 40-50% faster), public pages that grew from 50 to 1,300 viewers. Reduced new-feature development time 25% through reusable UI architecture.

   Rebuilt the platform across web, backend and mobile in under a month. Savings and lending app with 5,000+ MAU and a 4.8 App Store rating. Led code review, mentoring and delivery. 40% faster transactions, 30% better checkout success, 35% less KYC drop-off, 45% faster feature builds. Interviewed and onboarded seven engineers and designers.

   Multi-user UX research platform for 500+ enterprise clients, with Stripe and PayPal. 31 public pull requests to Dowell Scale Function.
